fill.[ENGAGEMENT NAME]: Order Alerts and Weekly Sales Report
fill.[COVER SUBTITLE]: Every new order reaches the right person in minutes, and Monday starts with one clear sales report.
fill.[SITUATION TITLE]: Orders Wait For Someone To Notice
fill.[SITUATION LEAD]: Orders from the store and from two marketplaces arrive in three different inboxes, and the team finds out hours later.
fill.[SITUATION DETAIL]: Jordan builds the Monday sales numbers by hand from three exports. Nothing tells the team a large order has arrived, and the weekly numbers are usually a day late.
fill.[COST LINE 1]: Large orders sit unnoticed for hours, and some ship late.
fill.[COST LINE 2]: About three hours every Monday go to copying numbers between exports.
fill.[AFTER TITLE]: Every order reaches the right person, and Monday is ready
fill.[AFTER BODY]: A new order from any of the three sources triggers an alert to the right person within minutes. The weekly sales report builds itself and arrives before the Monday meeting.
fill.[SCOPE INTRO]: Three order sources feed one place. The alert rules come first, then the weekly report reads from the same data.
fill.[WEEK 1 SUMMARY]: Store and marketplace orders flowing into one place.
fill.[WEEK 2 SUMMARY]: Alert rules built and tested on real orders.
fill.[WEEK 3 SUMMARY]: Alerts live for the team, weekly sales report built.
fill.[WEEK 4 SUMMARY]: Weekly report live, walkthrough recorded, support window opens.
